name: Folie Fatale ~Yandere Otoko ni Otosareru~
original_name: Folie Fatale ～病ンデレ男に堕とされる～
source:
The protagonist, Natsuki Sakuraba, is an ordinary female student attending a private school Kirigaya Private Academy. But there is something about Natsuki that seems to attract "landmine men" to her

A stalker, a menhera, a yandere, an egoist…

"Please stop this! Even though I tried so hard not to remember!"

After getting used to her every day life, thinking that things have calmed down and dropping her guard, one morning she is once again greeted with chaos as she opens her shoe locker to find it full of letters addressed to her.

Can she really escape her fate!?

[from [url=https://yankeebanchou.wordpress.com/2024/01/02/2024-overview-upcoming-otome-josei-muke-bl-games/#more-55510]Yankee Banchou[/url]]
translation:
主人公樱庭夏树是私立学校桐谷学园的一名普通女学生。但夏树身上似乎有一种吸引“地雷人”的特质

跟踪狂、曼赫拉、病态者、利己主义者……

“请停止吧！尽管我努力不去回忆！”

习惯了日常生活，以为事情已经平静下来，放下了警惕，一天早上，她再次陷入混乱，打开鞋柜，发现里面装满了写给她的信。

她真的能逃脱命运吗！？

[来自[url=https://yankeebanchou.wordpress.com/2024/01/02/2024-overview-upcoming-otome-josei-muke-bl-games/#more-55510]Yankee Banchou[/url]]
